entities.summary: Larry Augustin is a former VP at Amazon Web Services. He formerly was the chairman of the board of directors of SugarCRM. He is a former venture capitalist and the founder of VA Software. During the height of the dot-com bubble, Augustin was a billionaire on paper at the age of 38.
